question: Should this PR be narrowed to the LM Studio classifier transport, and must non-loopback model endpoints require explicit remote-transmission consent plus durable asset/endpoint evidence?
rationale: Repository policy establishes privacy-first and read-only boundaries, but the permanent endpoint policy and whether the unrelated agent-facing export surface belongs in this change require maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow and harden
options.body: Keep the LM Studio classifier work, remove or split the export surface, default to loopback endpoints, and require explicit remote consent with durable transmission evidence.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Keep the PR open as a draft until maintainers define a combined remote-classification and agent-export security model.

recommendation.title: Narrow and harden
recommendation.body: Keep the LM Studio classifier work, remove or split the export surface, default to loopback endpoints, and require explicit remote consent with durable transmission evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes repository-wide privacy policy and the public command surface rather than requiring only a mechanical code repair.
